claims.result: Three-component model matches line profiles and low/intermediate velocity channel maps

evidence.quote: The best-fit model reconstructing the gas envelope has satisfactorily reproduced the line profiles, channel maps

claims.hypothesis: Can radiation pressure alone drive the fast outflow?
claims.result: Would take about 3300 yr versus kinematic timescale 160 yr
claims.finding: Radiation pressure insufficient; momentum excess of ~20
